# starrocks_catalog (Data Source)

Reads metadata for a StarRocks catalog. Works for both external catalogs and the built-in `default_catalog`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "starrocks_catalog" "default" {
  name = "default_catalog"
}

output "catalog_type" {
  value = data.starrocks_catalog.default.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The catalog name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) The catalog comment as reported by StarRocks.
- `type` (String) The catalog type as reported by StarRocks (e.g. `Internal`, `Hive`, `Iceberg`).
